tasks.instruction: Greet the person by the fridge, then return to the home posture.
Find out what is on the island and explore the living room.
Roll the rolling pin, pull it toward you and centre it on the island.
Lay the juice bottle down, then stand it up again.
Turn the paperback book over on the island.
Hand the rolling pin to the left hand and open and close the low cabinet while holding it.
Show a wooden block to the camera, then steady the mug with the left hand.
Square one block with the island, then stack the other on it rotated and touch it.
Sweep the two wooden blocks together, then push one aside.
Put the mug on the stove, switch the burner on for a few seconds and off again.
Knock on the low cabinet, look inside, open it and close it again.
Heat the oatmeal in the microwave with its start key, then stop the microwave.
Move a block to the stove, put it back where it was, then swap it with the soda can.
Group two blocks and the can on the island, then sort the can into the trash and a block onto the stove.
Empty the mug of tomatoes into the pot.
